lessons: The merge gate failed only tests/integration/test_daemon_soak_runner.py::test_daemon_soak_runs_production_serve. That test builds its own repo under tmp_path and never reads README.md or docs/, and the same suite passed 3311/3311 at checks. The docs-only diff did not cause it.

Redo the same work from the merge base: rewrite README.md with the eight sections in the ticket's order, all links absolute https://, and ./dev.py only under ## Developing chupa. Change only the first sentence of section 1 in docs/how-chupa-works.md. Review approved this approach with no findings.

If the soak test fails again, run the plain ./dev.py test once in a base-commit git worktree with full history and no env overrides before calling it pre-existing. If it fails there too, file it with chupa suggest as a flaky test. Do not edit the test or anything else outside the ticket's fence.
Do not touch tests/, chupa/, or pyproject.toml to make the gate pass. The scope fence allows only README.md and docs/how-chupa-works.md.
